segments.headline: SAVED TIME IS NOT PROFIT
segments.body: Your AI agent saved 67 hours. Your expenses still rose.
segments.spoken: Your AI agent saved sixty-seven hours, but your expenses still rose. Here is the missing calculation.

segments.headline: TASKS PER MONTH
segments.body: Four minutes saved each = 66.7 hours of capacity.
segments.spoken: One thousand monthly tasks, multiplied by four minutes saved per task, equals sixty-six point seven hours of capacity. Not automatic payroll savings.

segments.headline: POTENTIAL VALUE
segments.body: 66.7 hours x $30 per hour. Only valuable if realized.
segments.spoken: At thirty dollars an hour, that is about two thousand dollars in potential capacity value. You need reduced expenses or productive redeployment to realize the value.

segments.headline: MONTHLY AI COSTS
segments.spoken: Now include operating costs. Three hundred fifty dollars for infrastructure, six hundred for human review, and five hundred for integration support. Total, fourteen hundred fifty dollars.

segments.headline: CONDITIONAL NET BENEFIT
segments.body: $2,000 potential value minus $1,450 costs. Not guaranteed cash savings.
segments.spoken: Your modeled net benefit is five hundred fifty dollars, only if you realize the entire two thousand dollars in capacity value. Without that value, your business case is negative.

segments.headline: MEASURE REALIZED ROI
segments.body: Track cost per task, errors, rework and cash impact.
segments.spoken: Measure cost per completed task, errors, rework, and verified financial value. PrismBay AI helps founders and operators implement practical AI business systems.
